# Kalyan Elevators

> Kalyan Elevators Pvt. Ltd. was established in Thrissur in 2018, starting with lift AMC and modernisation, and has offices in Thrissur and Kochi. It makes luxury home lifts in four finishes (Golden Mirror, Rose Gold Mirror, Black Mirror, Full Glass) that install in existing homes and houses under construction, and provides passenger, MRL, hospital, commercial, capsule and panoramic lifts with installation and service.

- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 79949 98880 (also +91 79949 99926)
- Google: 5.0 from 140 reviews (Kalyan Elevators PVT Ltd, Thrissur)
- Thrissur office: TMC 36/2551, Third Floor, Jomsons Tower, Post Office Road, Thrissur 680001
- Kochi office: 2nd Floor, Ruqia Chambers, Kovilvattam Junction, TD Road, Kochi 682035

## Home lift designs (listed prices)

- [Luxury Golden Lift Designs](https://kalyanelevators.com/designs/luxury-golden-lift): Rs 20,00,000. 1.2 m x 1.2 m room, 200 kg, hydraulic.
- [Luxury Designs, golden mirror etched design](https://kalyanelevators.com/designs/luxury-designs-gold-cabin): Rs 25,00,000. 1.2 m x 1.2 m room, 200 kg, hydraulic.
- [Luxury Curved Glass Lift Design](https://kalyanelevators.com/designs/luxury-curved-glass-lift): Rs 28,00,000. 1.80 m x 1.50 m room, 272 kg, hydraulic or traction.
- [Premium Luxury Design](https://kalyanelevators.com/designs/premium-luxury-design): Rs 30,00,000. 1.2 m x 1.2 m room, 200 kg, hydraulic.
- [Luxury Lift For Luxury Homes](https://kalyanelevators.com/designs/luxury-lift-for-luxury-homes): Rs 30,00,000. 1.2 m x 1.2 m room, 200 kg, hydraulic.
- [Luxury Designs, glass lift](https://kalyanelevators.com/designs/luxury-designs-glass-lift): Rs 30,00,000. 1.2 m x 1.2 m room, 200 kg, hydraulic.

Brochure planning: home lift configuration with 230V AC single-phase power and a 300 mm pit; requirements must be confirmed for the selected design/site. Brochure control options include ARD, floor announcements and fireman operation; inclusion is package-specific. Other services include goods/freight lifts, car lifts, dumbwaiters and escalators.

Every catalogue design: steel structure lift room with glass cladding, single or three phase power, customised cabin and colours, less pit and overhead, one side wall mounted, emergency landing switches, installs in pre-existing homes, wheelchair lift possible, 24 hours service.
